title: Conway refinement for omnific integers
abstract: Proves multiplicative refinement for omnific integers: every equality ab = cd admits a two-by-two factor refinement. Develops factorization and refinement of generalized power-series integer parts and connects these to surreal-number and standalone Mathlib formulations.

informal.ConwayRefinement.Palomar.conwayRefinemen: If four omnific integers satisfy ab = cd, there are omnific integers e, f, g, h with a = ef, b = gh, c = eg, and d = fh, including degenerate cases.
